name: aglink-vscode
description: Lets aglink-web read and act in this VS Code window — files, problems, terminal output — so an agent in another window can see what this one is doing without screen capture. Also lends the aglink desktop app's voice to Claude Code: speak a request, hear the answer.

aglink.enabled.description: Connect this window to the aglink-web daemon. Turn off to keep this window out of reach of aglink-web's vscode_* tools.

aglink.port.description: aglink-web daemon port. 0 reads it from ~/.aglink/aglink-web.port, falling back to 48219.
